ps.en: On her first week of [[training]] at a software firm, Lin was [[confined|confine]] to a windowless archive room, where old servers still kept their original [[configuration]]. Her manager explained that the rule protected [[confidential]] files, and she had to [[confirm]] every request for access in writing.
ps.zh: 在一家软件公司接受入职培训的第一周，小林被安排待在一间没有窗户的档案室里，那里的旧服务器还保留着最初的配置。经理解释说，这条规定是为了保护机密文件，每一次查阅申请她都必须书面确认。

ps.en: The dull work did not [[conflict]] with her nature. Years of long [[train]] rides to school had given her the quiet [[confidence]] of someone who notices details — a useful [[trait]] in an archive. Soon she felt [[confident]] enough to ask why one folder was empty.
ps.zh: 这份枯燥的工作并不与她的性子相抵触。多年坐长途火车上学的经历，让她养成了一种留意细节的沉静自信——这在档案室里是个有用的特质。很快，她就有把握开口发问：为什么有一个文件夹是空的。

ps.en: That question led her to a [[trail]] of deleted emails and copied passwords. In her [[view]], the files had been stolen, not lost; from a legal [[viewpoint]], however, suspicion was not proof. She printed the logs, locked the door, and walked to the manager's office with the folder in her hands.
ps.zh: 这个问题引着她发现了一串踪迹：被删除的邮件和被复制的密码。在她看来，文件是被偷走的，不是丢失的；然而从法律的角度看，怀疑不等于证据。她打印了日志，锁上门，拿着那个文件夹朝经理办公室走去。

ps.en: The game was a [[virtual]] city where players could act out [[violent]] fantasies, and its maker claimed no real [[violence]] could come of it. When a twelve-year-old hurt a classmate after playing all night, the harm became [[apparent]] to everyone.
ps.zh: 那款游戏是一座虚拟城市，玩家可以在里面把暴力的幻想付诸行动，而开发商声称这不会带来任何真实的暴力。直到一个十二岁的孩子通宵游戏后打伤了同学，伤害才变得人人都看得清楚。

ps.en: A parents' group launched an [[appeal]] for stricter rules, and a retired teacher, Ms. Zhou, was [[appointed|appoint]] to mediate. At their first [[appointment]], the company's lawyers did not [[appear]]; only an assistant came, whose polite [[appearance]] hid a cold message: the rules were not [[applicable]] to games.
ps.zh: 一个家长团体发出呼吁，要求出台更严格的规定，退休教师周女士被任命从中调解。第一次约见时，公司的律师没有到场，只来了一位助理，那副彬彬有礼的外表下藏着一句冷冰冰的话：这些规定不适用于游戏。

ps.en: Ms. Zhou studied the firm's licence [[application]] and found the law could [[apply]] after all: the headset was registered as a household [[appliance]]. Her quiet [[virtue]] was patience, and she used it. When the company finally agreed to limit playtime, the parents learned to [[appreciate]] a victory that arrived without shouting.
ps.zh: 周女士研究了这家公司的执照申请书，发现法律终究还是用得上的：那台头显是以家用电器的名义注册的。她身上那种沉静的美德是耐心，而她把它用到了极致。当公司最终同意限制游戏时长时，家长们学会了珍惜这场不曾靠怒吼赢来的胜利。

ps.en: For his graduation [[essay]], Chen chose to [[discuss]] why one [[industrial]] town had more lung [[disease]] than any other in the province. Older doctors tended to [[discriminate]] between patients by surname, as if [[ethnic]] background, not smoke, were the cause. The true cause, Chen believed, had simply [[escaped|escape]] notice.
ps.zh: 毕业论文里，小陈选择探讨一个问题：为什么这座工业城镇的肺病比全省任何地方都多。老医生们习惯按姓氏区别对待病人，仿佛病因在于族裔背景，而不是烟尘。小陈相信，真正的病因只是被忽视了。

ps.en: The town had been [[industrialized|industrialize]] in a single decade; its whole [[industry]] was one steel plant. Chen's first task was to [[establish]] the facts and [[estimate]] how many workers were sick — [[especially]] those who lived downwind. Numbers alone, his professor warned, were not the [[essence]] of the problem; a work [[ethic]] that praised endless overtime was just as guilty.
ps.zh: 这座城镇在短短十年里就完成了工业化，它的全部产业就是一座钢厂。小陈的第一项任务是查明事实，并估算有多少工人患病——尤其是那些住在下风向的人。导师提醒他，光有数字并不是问题的本质；一种赞美无休止加班的工作伦理，同样难辞其咎。

ps.en: To [[evaluate]] the company's reports, Chen compared them with hospital records — slow work, but [[essential]]. His conclusion was simple: a town's health could not be traded for output. Once the essay was published, no one in the town could honestly look away.
ps.zh: 为了评估公司的报告，小陈把它们与医院的病历逐一比对——这项工作很慢，但必不可少。他的结论很简单：一座城镇的健康，不能拿去换产值。文章发表之后，镇上再也没有人能心安理得地视而不见了。

ps.en: On the [[outer]] edge of the city, Aunt Mei ran a food stall from a cart that was a [[mixture]] of kitchen, shop and home. Rainy days made her [[miserable]]; the awning leaked, and she would [[mix]] her tea with rainwater half the time.
ps.zh: 在城市的外缘，梅姨用一辆推车经营着一个食摊，那辆车是厨房、店铺和家的混合物。下雨天让她苦不堪言：雨棚漏水，她的茶一半时间都在和雨水混在一起。

ps.en: When the landlord raised the rent, Mei refused to be [[misled|mislead]] by his talk of market forces. She counted her coins and decided that bargaining was a [[necessity]], not a shame. The long dry season had [[necessitated|necessitate]] smaller portions; now plain honesty was [[necessary]] too. So she went to [[negotiate]].
ps.zh: 房东涨租的时候，梅姨拒绝被他那套「市场规律」的说辞误导。她数了数硬币，认定讨价还价是生活必需，不是什么丢脸的事。漫长的旱季已经逼得她减少了分量；如今，坦诚也变得必要。于是，她去找房东谈判。

ps.en: The landlord called her stall a [[negative]] influence on the street, but Mei answered calmly: change was [[inevitable]], yet respect cost nothing. In the end they settled on a fair rent, and her [[misery]] found an [[outlet]] — she opened a tiny soup window for night-shift workers, and laughter returned to the cart.
ps.zh: 房东说她的摊位对这条街有负面影响，梅姨却平静地回答：变化不可避免，但尊重不花一分钱。最终，他们谈妥了一个公道的租金，而她的愁苦也找到了一个出口——她为夜班工人开了一扇小小的汤品窗口，笑声又回到了这辆推车上。

words.exam: 使不外出；禁闭；限制；使局限
c: be confined to 被限制在
confine sth to 把…限定在
confine sb to bed 使卧床
fam: confined adj. 有限的；被禁闭的
words.dif: confine to 强调「限制在某个范围」；limit 泛指「限量」，confirm 是「证实」，形近义远
words.pat: The discussion should not be confined to a single department.
words.patZh: 这场讨论不应局限于一个部门。

c: confirm sth in writing 书面确认
confirm that... 证实…
confirm a booking 确认预订
words.dif: confirm 是「证实为真」；conform 是「遵守、符合」，两者只差一个字母，完形常设
words.pat: Further evidence is needed to confirm the initial findings.
words.patZh: 初步发现还需要更多证据来证实。

c: in conflict with 与…相抵触
a conflict of interest 利益冲突
conflict with 与…冲突
fam: con-（共同）+ flict（打击） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: conflict 可指长期冲突或抽象抵触；clash 是短促激烈的正面冲撞；combat 是战斗
words.pat: Personal values sometimes conflict with workplace rules.
words.patZh: 个人价值观有时会与职场规则相冲突。

c: have confidence in 对…有信心
gain / lose confidence 获得/失去信心
with confidence 有把握地
in strict confidence 绝对保密
words.dif: confidence 是「信心」；confidential 是「机密的」，同源不同义，阅读常用来设坑
words.pat: Public confidence in data security has been shaken.
words.patZh: 公众对数据安全的信心已经动摇。

c: be confident of / about 对…有信心
feel confident enough to do 觉得足够有信心去做
a confident smile 自信的微笑
words.dif: confident 是形容词「自信的」；confidential 是「机密的」，词尾 -ent / -ential 别混
words.pat: She felt confident that the truth would come out.
words.patZh: 她确信真相终会大白。

c: confidential information 机密信息
keep sth confidential 对…保密
a confidential document 机密文件
words.dif: confidential 是「机密的」；confident 是「自信的」；classified 是「列为密级的」
words.pat: Medical records are confidential and must not be shared.
words.patZh: 病历属于机密，不得外传。

c: the original configuration 初始配置
system configuration 系统配置
the configuration of a room 房间布局
fam: con-（一起）+ figure（形状） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: configuration 指「各部分的排布方式」；construction 是「建造、构造过程」
words.pat: The new configuration of the office saves a great deal of space.
words.patZh: 办公室的新布局节省了大量空间。

c: a trail of 一连串…的痕迹
follow a trail 追踪线索
a mountain trail 山间小道
leave a trail 留下痕迹
words.dif: trail 是「拖在后面留下的痕迹」；track 是「足迹、轨道」；trace 是「微量痕迹」
words.pat: Digital payments leave a trail that investigators can follow.
words.patZh: 数字支付会留下调查人员可以顺藤摸瓜的痕迹。

words.exam: 列车；火车；训练；培养；一系列，一串
c: take / catch a train 乘/赶火车
train sb to do 培训…做
a train of thought 思路
a train of events 一连串事件
words.dif: train 作动词是「培训」；trail 是「追踪」，形近常混；trainee 指「受训的人」
words.pat: A well-trained workforce is the best asset of any company.
words.patZh: 训练有素的员工是任何公司最好的资产。

c: job training 职业培训
undergo / receive training 接受培训
a training course 培训课程
in training 在受训中
words.dif: training 侧重「技能训练」；education 侧重「系统教育」；exercise 是「身体锻炼」
words.pat: On-the-job training is often more valuable than a degree.
words.patZh: 在职培训往往比一纸文凭更有价值。

c: a personality trait 性格特质
an inherited trait 遗传特征
a common trait of... （相关常用表达）
words.dif: trait 指「性格或遗传上的特征」；trace 是「痕迹」；trail 是「踪迹」，三者形近
words.pat: Patience is a trait that no school can teach.
words.patZh: 耐心是一种学校教不会的特质。

c: in one's view 在某人看来
view... as... 把…看作
a view of 对…的看法
with a view to 为了，着眼于
words.dif: view 是「个人看法或眼前之景」；scenery 是「自然风景（不可数）」；scene 是「一幕场景」
words.pat: Many people view failure as a necessary part of learning.
words.patZh: 许多人把失败看作学习的必经之路。

c: from a legal / practical viewpoint 从法律、实际角度看
share one's viewpoint （相关常用表达）
a narrow viewpoint （相关常用表达）
words.dif: viewpoint 强调「看问题的立足点」；opinion 强调「对某事的判断结论」
words.pat: From an environmental viewpoint, the project is a step backward.
words.patZh: 从环保的角度看，这个项目是一种倒退。

c: domestic violence 家庭暴力
an act of violence 暴力行为
resort to violence 诉诸暴力
words.dif: violence 是「暴力行为」；violation 是「违反、侵犯」，形近义不同
words.pat: Exposure to online violence harms children's development.
words.patZh: 接触网络暴力损害儿童的成长。

c: a violent crime 暴力犯罪
violent fantasies 暴力幻想
a violent storm 猛烈的暴风雨
words.dif: violent 既可指「暴力的」也可指「剧烈的（风暴、疼痛）」；fierce 只指「猛烈的」
words.pat: Violent content in games should carry a clear age rating.
words.patZh: 游戏中的暴力内容应当标明清晰的年龄分级。

c: virtual reality 虚拟现实
a virtual monopoly 实际上的垄断
virtual meetings 线上会议
words.dif: virtual 两个义项常考：「虚拟的」与「实际上的」；virtually 多译为「几乎」
words.pat: The internet has made remote work a virtual necessity.
words.patZh: 互联网已经让远程办公成为事实上的必需。

c: by virtue of 凭借，由于
the virtue of patience 耐心的美德
have the virtue of 有…的优点
words.dif: by virtue of 是固定搭配「凭借」；virtue 本身指「美德」，vice 是其反义「恶习」
words.pat: By virtue of hard work, she rose from trainee to manager.
words.patZh: 凭借努力，她从管培生做到了经理。

c: it is apparent that... 显然…
become apparent 变得明显
apparent reason 表面上的理由
words.dif: apparent 既可指「明显的」也可指「貌似真实的」，阅读里要按语境分辨
words.pat: It soon became apparent that the two goals could not both be met.
words.patZh: 很快就可以明显看出，两个目标无法兼得。

words.exam: 有吸引力；上诉；申诉；呼吁；恳求；吸引力
c: appeal to sb for sth 向…呼吁
appeal to sb 对…有吸引力
file / lodge an appeal 提出上诉
launch an appeal 发起呼吁
words.dif: appeal to 三义常考：吸引、呼吁、上诉；appear 是「出现」，形近义远
words.pat: The idea of working from home appeals to many young people.
words.patZh: 居家办公的设想对许多年轻人很有吸引力。

c: appear in court 出庭
appear to do 似乎做
it appears that... 看来…
words.dif: appear to do 是「似乎做」；appear in 是「出现在某地」；不要漏掉 to 或误用进行时
words.pat: New technologies appear faster than laws can regulate them.
words.patZh: 新技术出现的速度超过了法律监管的速度。

c: judge by appearances 以貌取人
make an appearance 露面
keep up appearances 维持表面
fam: appear → appearance → apparent n. 相关延伸
words.dif: appearance 指「外观、外表」；apparition 是「幽灵幻影」，形近词勿混
words.pat: We should not judge people by appearance alone.
words.patZh: 我们不该单凭外表评判一个人。

c: a household appliance 家用电器
electrical appliances 电器
a kitchen appliance 厨房用具
words.dif: appliance 多指「家用电器」；device 泛指「装置」；application 是「申请、应用」，不是器具
words.pat: Energy-efficient appliances can cut household bills sharply.
words.patZh: 节能电器能大幅削减家庭开支。

c: be applicable to 适用于
applicable rules 适用规则
where applicable 在适用的情况下
words.dif: applicable to 后接「对象」；applied 是「应用（学科）的」，如 applied physics
words.pat: The same rule is not applicable to every situation.
words.patZh: 同一条规则并非适用于所有情形。

c: submit / file an application 提交申请
an application form 申请表
the application of 对…的应用
an application for 对…的申请
words.dif: application 兼「申请」与「应用」两义；appliance 是「器具」，二者只差两个字母
words.pat: Her application for the grant was approved within a week.
words.patZh: 她的补助金申请一周内就获批了。

c: appoint sb as / to be 任命…为
appoint sb to a post 委派…任职
an appointed time 约定的时间
fam: appointed adj. 被任命的；约定的
words.dif: appoint 强调「正式任命职务」；assign 是「分配任务」；disappoint 是「使失望」
words.pat: An independent expert was appointed to review the case.
words.patZh: 一位独立专家受命审查此案。

c: make / keep an appointment 预约、赴约
cancel an appointment 取消预约
the appointment of... 对…的任命
words.dif: appointment 是「预约、任命」；date 是「约会（私人）」；disappointment 是「失望」，别按词根猜
words.pat: Please make an appointment before visiting the office.
words.patZh: 来办公室之前请先预约。

c: apply for 申请
apply to 适用于
apply sth to sth 把…应用于
apply oneself to 致力于
words.dif: apply for 接「想要的东西」；apply to 接「受理对象或适用对象」，介词是考点
words.pat: The lessons of history apply to the choices we face today.
words.patZh: 历史的教训同样适用于我们今天面临的选择。

c: appreciate doing sth 感激做…
I would appreciate it if... 如蒙…不胜感激
appreciate the value of 认识到…的价值
words.dif: appreciate 后接动名词不接不定式；「感激」的对象是事不是人，说 thank sb 不说 appreciate sb
words.pat: Only after losing it do people appreciate the value of time.
words.patZh: 人们往往在失去之后才懂得珍惜时间的价值。

c: discriminate against 歧视
discriminate between A and B 区分 A 与 B
discriminate in favour of 偏袒
words.dif: discriminate between 是中性「区分」；discriminate against 是贬义「歧视」，介词决定褒贬
words.pat: The law forbids employers to discriminate against older workers.
words.patZh: 法律禁止雇主歧视年长员工。

c: discuss sth with sb 与…讨论
discuss whether / how to do （相关常用表达）
a much-discussed issue 热议话题
words.dif: discuss 是及物动词，直接接宾语，不说 discuss about；about 属于中式英语
words.pat: The report discusses how automation affects small towns.
words.patZh: 这份报告探讨了自动化如何影响小城镇。

c: suffer from a disease 患病
prevent / cure a disease （相关常用表达）
an infectious disease 传染病
heart disease 心脏病
fam: dis-（不）+ ease（舒适） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: disease 指「具体的疾病（可数）」；illness 指「生病的状态」；discomfort 只是「不适」
words.pat: Air pollution is linked to a rise in lung disease.
words.patZh: 空气污染与肺病发病率上升有关。

c: escape from 从…逃脱
escape notice / attention 被忽视
escape doing sth 避免做…
a narrow escape 死里逃生
words.dif: escape notice 是惯用语「未被注意」；escape 后接动名词，不接不定式
words.pat: No important detail escaped the researcher's attention.
words.patZh: 没有任何重要细节逃过这位研究者的注意。

c: especially when 尤其当…
especially for 尤其对…而言
not especially 并不特别
words.dif: especially 强调「超出一般地」；specially 强调「专门地（为某目的）」，完形常互设
words.pat: Sleep matters for everyone, especially for growing teenagers.
words.patZh: 睡眠对每个人都重要，对成长中的青少年尤其如此。

c: write an essay on 写一篇关于…的文章
a graduation essay 毕业论文
a collection of essays 文集
words.dif: essay 是「论说文、短论文」；article 是「报刊文章」；paper 是「学术论文」
words.pat: A good essay argues a point instead of listing facts.
words.patZh: 好文章要论证观点，而不是罗列事实。

c: the essence of ……的本质
in essence 本质上
of the essence 至关重要的
words.dif: essence 是名词「本质」；essential 是形容词「必不可少的」；两词常连在一起考
words.pat: In essence, education is about forming judgment, not memory.
words.patZh: 本质上，教育培养的是判断力，而不是记忆力。

words.exam: 必不可少的；本质的；基本的
c: be essential to / for 对…必不可少
it is essential that... 必须…
essential services 基本服务
words.dif: essential to 接名词；it is essential that 从句用虚拟语气（should do），这是语法考点
words.pat: Access to clean water is essential to public health.
words.patZh: 获得清洁用水对公共健康必不可少。

c: establish the facts 查明事实
establish a company 创办公司
establish oneself as 确立…的地位
establish contact 建立联系
words.dif: establish 兼有「建立」与「查实」两义，阅读中「证实」义项常被忽略
words.pat: The investigation established that the data had been altered.
words.patZh: 调查证实数据曾被篡改。

c: estimate sth at 估算为
it is estimated that... 据估计
a rough estimate 粗略估计
give an estimate 给出估价
words.dif: estimate 是「基于信息的估计」；guess 是「无根据的猜测」；evaluate 是「评估价值」
words.pat: It is estimated that a third of the food produced is wasted.
words.patZh: 据估计，生产出的食物有三分之一被浪费。

words.exam: 道德体系；道德准则；行为准则；伦理学
c: a work ethic 职业道德
professional ethics 职业伦理
a code of ethics 行为准则
words.dif: ethic 指「一套道德准则」；ethnic 是「民族的」，两词形近义远，阅读常设干扰
words.pat: A strong work ethic cannot excuse endless overtime.
words.patZh: 再强的职业伦理也不能为无休止的加班开脱。

c: ethnic groups 族群
ethnic background 族裔背景
ethnic minorities 少数民族
ethnic diversity 族群多样性
words.dif: ethnic 强调「文化与族群」；racial 强调「生理上的种族」；national 是「国家的」
words.pat: The city is home to people of many ethnic backgrounds.
words.patZh: 这座城市生活着众多不同族裔背景的人。

c: evaluate the effectiveness of 评估…的效果
evaluate sth against 对照…评估
critically evaluate 批判性评估
words.dif: evaluate 重「判断价值与效果」；estimate 重「估算数量」；assess 重「核定等级」
words.pat: Students should learn to evaluate online information critically.
words.patZh: 学生应学会批判性地评估网络信息。

c: industrial pollution 工业污染
an industrial town 工业城镇
the Industrial Revolution 工业革命
industrial output 工业产值
words.dif: industrial 是「工业的」；industrious 是「勤劳的」，同源不同义，极易互设陷阱
words.pat: Many industrial towns are struggling to reinvent themselves.
words.patZh: 许多工业城镇正在艰难地转型。

c: a highly industrialized country 高度工业化的国家
industrialize rapidly 迅速工业化
the industrializing world 工业化进程中的世界
fam: industry n. → industrial adj. → industrialize v. → industrialization n.
words.dif: industrialize 是动词；industrialization 是名词「工业化进程」，词性转换常考
words.pat: Countries that industrialized late often polluted the most.
words.patZh: 工业化起步晚的国家，往往污染也最重。

c: the service industry 服务业
heavy industry 重工业
the tourist industry 旅游业
a pillar industry 支柱产业
words.dif: industry 泛指「某一行业」；factory 是具体的「工厂」；manufacture 是「制造过程」
words.pat: The tech industry now employs more people than mining.
words.patZh: 如今科技行业的从业人数已超过采矿业。

words.exam: 不可避免的；必然发生的
c: it is inevitable that... …不可避免
an inevitable consequence 必然结果
the inevitable 不可避免之事
words.dif: inevitable 是「无法避免的」；unbelievable 是「难以置信的」，别被 in- 前缀带偏
words.pat: Some job losses are inevitable as technology advances.
words.patZh: 随着技术进步，部分岗位流失不可避免。

c: feel miserable 感到痛苦
miserable weather 糟糕的天气
a miserable failure 惨败
words.dif: miserable 既可指「内心痛苦」也可指「糟糕透顶的（天气、表现）」；miserly 是「吝啬的」，形近义远
words.pat: Long commutes make many city workers miserable.
words.patZh: 漫长的通勤让许多城市上班族苦不堪言。

c: live in misery 生活在痛苦中
put sb out of their misery 结束…的痛苦
the misery of unemployment 失业之苦
words.dif: misery 是名词「痛苦」；mystery 是「神秘」，只差一个字母，拼写题常混
words.pat: The policy brought misery to thousands of small vendors.
words.patZh: 这项政策给成千上万的小摊贩带来了苦难。

c: mislead sb into doing 误导…去做
mislead sb about 使…对…产生误解
deliberately mislead 蓄意误导
fam: misled（过去式 / 过去分词） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: mislead 的过去式是 misled，不是 misleaded；mislead 是「使人走错路」，mistake 是「自己弄错」
words.pat: Advertisements must not mislead consumers about safety.
words.patZh: 广告不得在安全性上误导消费者。

c: mix A with B 把 A 与 B 混合
mix up 混淆
mix with sb 与…交往
oil and water don't mix 格格不入
words.dif: mix A with B 是「混合」；mix up A and B 是「搞混、认错」，一个 up 意思全变
words.pat: Good teaching mixes theory with hands-on practice.
words.patZh: 好的教学把理论与动手实践结合起来。

c: a mixture of ……的混合体
a strange mixture of feelings 百感交集
a chemical mixture 化学混合物
words.dif: mixture 强调「混合而成的整体」；compound 是「化合物」；combination 是「组合方式」
words.pat: The city is a mixture of old temples and glass towers.
words.patZh: 这座城市是古老庙宇与玻璃高楼的混合体。

c: it is necessary (for sb) to do （相关常用表达）
if necessary 如有必要
a necessary condition 必要条件
do what is necessary （相关常用表达）
words.dif: necessary 拼写陷阱：一个 c、两个 s；necessary condition 与 sufficient condition（充分条件）是逻辑常考点
words.pat: It is necessary to act before the problem grows worse.
words.patZh: 必须在问题恶化之前采取行动。

c: necessitate doing sth 使…成为必要
be necessitated by 由…所迫
necessitate a change 需要作出改变
fam: necessary adj. → necessitate v. → necessity n.
words.dif: necessitate 是正式书面语「使必须」；need 口语通用；require 语气居中
words.pat: The drought necessitated strict limits on water use.
words.patZh: 干旱迫使人们严格限制用水。

c: out of necessity 出于必要
a daily necessity 日常必需品
the necessity of doing 做…的必要性
of necessity 必然地
words.dif: necessity 可作可数「必需品」或不可数「必要性」；luxury 是其反义「奢侈品」
words.pat: For many families, a second income is a necessity, not a choice.
words.patZh: 对许多家庭而言，双份收入是必需，而非选择。

c: a negative influence 负面影响
negative feedback 负面反馈
test negative 检测呈阴性
a negative attitude 消极态度
words.dif: negative 是「负面的、否定的」；negligent 是「疏忽的」，形近勿混；反义 positive
words.pat: Negative reviews can destroy a small business overnight.
words.patZh: 负面评价能在一夜之间毁掉一家小商家。

c: negotiate with sb 与…谈判
negotiate a deal / contract 谈成一笔交易、一份合同
negotiate over 就…磋商
negotiate one's way 设法通过
words.dif: negotiate with 接「谈判对象」；negotiate about / over 接「谈判事项」，介词分工要明确
words.pat: Small firms must learn to negotiate with powerful platforms.
words.patZh: 小企业必须学会与强势的平台谈判。

c: the outer edge 外缘
outer space 外太空
the outer suburbs 远郊
an outer layer 外层
fam: out → outer → outermost adj. 最外面的
words.dif: outer 强调「位置靠外」；external 强调「来自外部的」；outdoor 是「户外的」
words.pat: Jobs are moving from city centres to the outer suburbs.
words.patZh: 工作岗位正从市中心迁往远郊。

words.exam: 出路；出口；发泄途径；经销店
c: an outlet for 发泄…的途径
an emotional outlet 情绪出口
a retail outlet 零售店
a power outlet 电源插座
fam: out + let（让…出去） n. 相关延伸
outlet store 奥特莱斯 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: outlet 可指「情绪出口」与「门店」两义；outcome 是「结果」，形近词义完全不同
words.pat: Everyone needs an outlet for stress, be it sport or music.
words.patZh: 每个人都需要一个宣泄压力的出口，无论是运动还是音乐。
